title: Expand combat classes, rose friendships, guild rally and realm rewards
details: Health and class resource values sit within the combat orbs; Guide, Quests and Announcements share the right castle rail without the duplicate inventory shortcut. Each class gains four active and four passive talents with painted existing skill icons and animation variants. Renewal Wave heals living party members for 8/16/24/32 percent max health. Campaign, Conquest, boss challenges, elite hunts, expeditions and Spire random drops use a 70 percent material / 30 percent gear split; guaranteed relic collection pieces and Spire chests remain intact. Relic wardens hit harder. Roses are server-owned, gold-purchasable and server-rolled on eligible reward claims; sending one to an accepted friend gives both heroes uncapped friendship health progression. Claimed activity/login/world/dice rewards gain ordinary materials and level/VIP-scaled gold. World Tree explorer and shared weekly Guild Rally milestones have server claim ledgers. Playable guild bank and bank-funded buff activation are retired without deleting balances. Normal and VIP 30-day boards receive additional ordinary materials. Tested signed-in rose purchase and desktop/mobile orb rendering.

title: Include the combat and progression overhaul in announcements
Overhaul combat hotbar, level quests, announcements, relic trials and activity board
details: Painted health and class-resource frames; phone skill rail keeps both meters visible. Guide and Quests now have separate castle shortcuts. Eight detailed quests per level retain existing claim ids. Announcements archive all recorded updates, fixes and merges and refresh from Git during builds. Relic ranks gain stronger HP, attack and defence with new sanctuary art. Beastwood, Ashroot and Arcane expeditions pay Beast Hide, Emberbloom and Arcane Crystal without new rare sources. Daily, weekly and login rewards have separate views, ready filters and stage-aware claims. Existing cloud payouts and player saves remain unchanged.

Daily quest board, barracks upgrades, gem workshop rework, arena fix (#5)
details:
- Quest Board: six fixed daily commissions (level, astrals, gems, training, wins, enhancements) that reset at Greek midnight and pay gold, XP and materials. The AI quest generator and its server function are gone.
- Barracks: upgrades to level 30 with an unlock list - batch sizes at 3/6/10/15 and instructor grades at 20/25/30, plus 2% cheaper training per level.
- Gem Workshop: empty sockets open a gem picker; with no gems it points at a cutting window that previews each gem's stats, effects and cost before you spend anything.
- Arena recent fights: fixed the win/loss flip by comparing the attacker against the hero id instead of the user id.

title: Greek-hour events and dailies, full inventory lists, clearer Forge salvaging (#4)
details:
- World events are pinned to the Europe/Athens clock, so openings land on the same round Greek hours all year instead of drifting with summer time. The event calendar defaults to Greek time and the server-side entry check uses the same schedule.
- Daily commissions reset at Greek midnight and pay 2 scrolls, 750 gold and 2 forge essence (migration 0010).
- Armory lists every forge material type and every gathered supply with exact counts, including the ones you have none of.
- Forge separates equipped gear from bag gear and requires a warning popup before salvaging worn gear.

title: Phone playability pass (#3)
details:
The castle screen was built for a wide window: the map is roughly 1500px wide
on a phone, most buildings sat off-screen with no way to reach them, and the two
bottom button strips overlapped each other and ran off the edge.

- The castle can now be dragged (mouse, touch or pen) and is clamped to its own
  edges, so every building is reachable on any screen. A tap still opens a
  building (only a real drag pans) and keyboard activation is unaffected.
- The two bottom strips become swipeable full-width rows on narrow screens,
  stacked above each other, so no button is clipped or unreachable. Desktop is
  unchanged.
- The HUD is compact on phones and wraps instead of overflowing: nothing is
  hidden, buttons stay >= 36px.
- The world chat moves above the two rows so it stops sitting on top of them.
- Notch and home-bar insets (safe-area) on the HUD, both strips, the chat and the
  battle top/bottom bars; viewport-fit=cover on the page.
- Panel headers and titles no longer overflow on a narrow panel, and the Forge
  gear grid shows 3 across on phones instead of overflowing at 6.
- Touch behaviour: no double-tap zoom delay, no pull-to-refresh overscroll, no
  tap highlight, no text selection while dragging the map, no hover cards on a
  swipe row, and a 40px minimum building tap target.
- A short "drag the castle" hint shows once on narrow screens and fades out.

title: Remove the boutique + carry resources as bag items (#2)
details:
- The Cosmetic Boutique is gone: its panel, its map marker and its entry in the
  game shell are removed.
- Three new resources drop from fights: Beast Hide (every win), Emberbloom
  (common drop, more from elites) and Arcane Crystal (elites and bosses).
- The Forge now shows a "Refine spare materials" card: 3 Beast Hide -> 1 Armor
  Fragment, 3 Emberbloom -> 1 Soul Essence, 3 Arcane Crystal -> 1 Starshard.
- Every material you carry is listed as an item stack in your bag, with its icon,
  rarity and count, above your gathering supplies.
- Battle reward lines now name the new materials as they drop.

title: Forge salvaging + Diamonds in the HUD (#1)
details: Blacksmith Forge can salvage bagged gear into materials (gems returned to the pouch), and Diamonds show next to Gold in the HUD on all screen sizes.
